## Houston 1.0.17

### What's new

- Preview PowerPoint presentations and other Office files inside Houston, and comment on a slide for your AI employee.
- Claude Fable 5.2 is now available.
- AI employees use your connected apps more reliably.
- Routines follow your time zone.
- Routines your AI employees set up use lighter models by default, so your AI plan lasts longer.
- You can reopen a checkout you closed, or start it over.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
